app.name: Wii Motion Synth
app.long_description:
A standalone Nintendo Wii homebrew application that turns your Wiimote into an interactive audio synthesizer with a real-time oscilloscope.
Controls: - Pitch (Tilt Up/Down): Adjusts Frequency - Roll (Twist L/R): Adjusts Volume - Hold B: Snap-to-Scale (Quantize) - Hold A: Square Wave (Default is Sine) - Hold 1: Sawtooth Wave - Hold 2: Octave Shift - D-Pad UP: Triangle Wave - D-Pad DWN: White Noise - D-Pad LFT: Pulse Wave - D-Pad RGT: Narrow Pulse - Hold PLUS: Mute Gate - MINUS: Toggle Oscilloscope / Stats UI - Nunchuk: Joystick controls LFO (Vibrato/Tremolo) - HOME: Exit
